text: The subject is Iqra Yousaf, who holds account PK**HABB****7071 opened on 18 November 2020. The subject declared an occupation as a Medical sales officer (salaried) with a declared monthly income of PKR 150,000 per month. Between 3 May 2026 and 28 May 2026, the account recorded 11 credits totalling PKR 16,964,000 and 4 debits totalling PKR 13,902,000. The account received 10 cash deposits totalling PKR 16,814,000 across 4 branches (Clifton Branch, DHA Phase 6 Branch, Gulshan-e-Iqbal Branch, Saddar Branch). An alert was raised by Tazama on 28 May 2026, where the Tazama typology STR-PK-01 scored 320 against an alert threshold of 300. 9 of 10 cash deposits (90%) were between PKR 1,600,000 and PKR 1,999,999, totalling PKR 15,984,000, which is indicative of repeated deposits just below the cash transaction reporting threshold of PKR 2,000,000. The cash deposits were spread across 4 branches (Clifton Branch, DHA Phase 6 Branch, Gulshan-e-Iqbal Branch, Saddar Branch), a pattern consistent with suspected structuring. The credits in the activity window were 113.1 times the declared monthly income of PKR 150,000 per month, which is inconsistent with the subject's declared financial profile. A note by Branch Operations on 16 May 2026 recorded that the customer asked why deposits of PKR 2 million or more need extra paperwork and declined to explain the source of the cash, which is indicative of an attempt to avoid reporting requirements. The combination of 9 of 10 cash deposits (90%) between PKR 1,600,000 and PKR 1,999,999, totalling PKR 15,984,000, across 4 branches (Clifton Branch, DHA Phase 6 Branch, Gulshan-e-Iqbal Branch, Saddar Branch), is consistent with suspected structuring to avoid the cash transaction reporting threshold of PKR 2,000,000. PKR 13,902,000 was sent to Al-Noor Exchange Company (PK**AL-N****1888, Synthetic Bank C) in 4 transactions. Debits equal to 82% of credits were made with a median of 14.4 hours between the latest credit and each debit. There was no match on sanctions, PEP or adverse-media screening on 30 May 2026. The account was placed under enhanced monitoring pending the reporting decision.
